prompts: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: playable island terrain background for Payitaht Ottoman–Aegean mobile strategy game. Produce a portrait 3:4 image, a complete large Mediterranean island centered in calm turquoise sea, orthographic elevated 2:1 isometric landscape, premium painterly-realistic game artwork. Broad usable grassland terraces with pale limestone winding paths between clearings, olive groves, cypress trees, rugged pale rocky northern hill, sandy coves, shallow turquoise shore. Warm upper-left sunlight and soft lower-right shadows, restrained ivory limestone, muted olive, dusty earth. No buildings, settlements, mines, people, labels, symbols, boxes or UI. Keep central and lower terrain largely open and clean for runtime town placement. Leave generous land clearings around normalized positions x/y .50/.16, .28/.28, .72/.30, .24/.43, .50/.47, .78/.49, .28/.64, .72/.69 and FOUR EXTRA spacious empty grassland terraces .27/.79, .52/.88, .77/.83, .52/.66, linked by natural limestone roads. All those positions must be land. These are natural clearings with no frames, no markings, no artificial grids. Island spans x .08-.92, y .07-.95 with narrow water border, no perspective horizon. Rich handcrafted realistic vegetation and rock texture, clean playable silhouette, detailed yet readable. No toy/cartoon look, no modern objects, no text, no watermark.

Landscape wide composition with main objects in middle vertical third so crops remain readable. No interface, lettering, logos, watermark, modern saw machinery, cartoon or saturated fantasy.
